'''Black Stall Station''' served as the hiding location of [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], where he kept the stolen [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] and [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]]. Cad Bane took [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to the station after a painful procedure of [[Mind trick/Legends|Force persuasion]].

==History==
[[File:BlackStallStationInterior-CotF.png|thumb|left|200px|The interior of Black Stall Station.]]
After emerging in the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]&ndash;strewn [[Rogue Antar system/Legends|system]] and docking to the outpost, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] left [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]] with the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and followed Bane into his base of operations. The [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] led them to the station's control room and pointed them to the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] on a table across the room. Although Bane volunteered to get the holocron for them, Windu refused to let the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] perform another trick.

However, Windu unintentionally activated the station's intruder alert system upon stepping into a hidden motion-sensing field on the floor. With alarms blaring and a [[Laser/Legends|laser]] system targeting the Jedi, Bane sneaked away from the distracted Kenobi and Windu, while the two were occupied. Kenobi pursued the bounty hunter, but the Duros escaped through a concealed hatch. Breaking out of his [[Binders/Legends|binders]], Bane fled Black Stall Station in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. Meanwhile, Kenobi managed to retrieve the holocron and both Jedi Masters managed to make their way back to the shuttle and depart just before the station exploded as a result of a self-destruct.
